title: feat(TableSelector): show warning when table list is truncated due to API page limit
body_excerpt: The useTables hook computes a hasMore flag when the backend has more tables than the current API response includes. However, this flag was never displayed to the user — the table list appeared complete when it was actually truncated. This PR adds a visible warning message below the table selector when hasMore is true, so users know to search/filter to find additional tables. title: Helm chart: replace `apache/superset:dockerize` initContainer with bash TCP wait
body_excerpt: ## Problem The Helm chart's initContainers use `apache/superset:dockerize` to wait on Postgres / Redis before Superset starts. The image is single-purpose, isn't on the regular Superset release/rebuild cadence, and tends to accumulate CVEs as its Alpine base ages out.
